name: issei-plugin
description: Issei's personal Claude Code setup. Vault skills (search-vault, distil-vault, lint-vault, challenge-vault, research-vault, weekly-vault-review), pipeline skills (harvest — weekly knowledge-base harvest with co-located Python scripts), voice skills (issei-voice for short-form chat, blog-voice for long-form technical writing), and meeting-agenda. Pure filesystem, no MCP, no slash commands. drawio-diagrams and skill-creator dropped in 0.3.0; covered by the team plugin.
